channel.title: Morocco - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Morocco, every source cited.

item.title: Canadian firm eyes Moroccan processing plant
item.description: Silver Hammer Mining is considering acquiring a 200-tonne daily capacity facility and indirect interests in local projects.

item.title: Morocco demands UN account for 350 vehicles, assets after MINURSO exit
item.description: The UN mission's mandate expired October 31, leaving infrastructure and equipment in Morocco's southern provinces facing an uncertain handover.

item.title: Morocco sees UN Sahara file closure after MINURSO mandate failure
item.description: Government spokesperson Samir Belfqih stated that Russia's veto of a UN resolution marks a new phase in the dispute.

item.title: Morocco's Nador West Med port attracts $5.5 billion investment
item.description: The Nador West Med complex aims to become a key maritime, industrial, and energy hub connecting Europe and Africa.

item.title: Morocco allocates 45.4 billion dirhams to health sector
item.description: The 2027 budget aims to improve access to care, from investments to medicines and staffing.
